comparison.objective: Register a windowed plate behind an inspection screen despite grasp-induced visual occlusion.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision plate placement, view management, and supported regrasp.
comparison.success_condition: Released, supported, stable registration within 3 mm for full credit or 12 mm for partial credit.
comparison.reason: Visual precision registration and occlusion management do not test mechanical tuning, fastener locking, or dynamic energy absorption.
